name: gmux
description: Lightweight macOS shell for agentic coding: durable named terminal sessions (private tmux server), git sidebar, decorated file tree, Monaco diff editor.
author: SpecStory

scripts.smoke:t1: npm run build && GMUX_SMOKE=create electron . && GMUX_SMOKE=verify electron .
scripts.smoke:t3: npm run build && GMUX_SMOKE=t3-prep electron . && GMUX_SMOKE=t3-verify electron .
scripts.icon: cd build && rm -rf icon.iconset icon.icns && mkdir -p icon.iconset && for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s icon.svg -o icon.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}.png; rsvg-convert -w $((s*2)) -h $((s*2)) icon.svg -o icon.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png; done && iconutil -c icns icon.iconset -o icon.icns && rm -rf icon.iconset
